target_customer: E-commerce merchants selling personalized products (phone cases, shirts, mugs) on Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy and Amazon
problem: Selling personalized products online is hard; Customily gives shoppers a live design preview and produces print-ready files for fulfillment.
business_model: Usage-based SaaS app subscription for merchants

founders.name: Martina Möring
founders.background_notes: YC page: from Uruguay, moved to St. Louis in 2020, background in architecture and design.

founders.name: Alejandro Lozdziejski
founders.background_notes: YC page: created the first open-source 3D printer in South America; listed as an MIT Technology Review Innovator under 35.

technical_complexity.rationale: Live product design preview embedded in stores and automated print-file generation across several e-commerce platforms; standard front end with some graphics-heavy parts.

defensibility.rationale: Merchant templates and platform integrations create some lock-in, but personalization widgets were copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found on incumbents copying it; the company lists integrations with Printify and Printful instead.

market_need_then: Growth of print-on-demand and demand for personalized products during the 2020 e-commerce surge; the company says its Shopify app launched in April 2020.

identity.voice_and_tone: Upbeat and sales focused, tagline Sell personalized products the smart way

branding.community_and_virality: Publishes customer success stories and case studies; Shopify app rating and install counts are self-reported.

brand_strength.rationale: Positioned as the number one personalizer app per its own site, but no independent press on the brand.

outcome_analysis: Customily appears to be a bootstrapped, growing e-commerce app company with about 30 staff and claims of over 21,000 Shopify installs. Public funding data is only from aggregators and varies widely, so it is unclear how much it raised. It has not been acquired or shut down, and the story rests on a founder history in 3D printing for personalization.
notes: Aggregators disagree on total raised (CB Insights 160K, TheCompanyCheck 125K, Caplight 300K, PitchBook 1.62M); none was confirmed by a press release, so no round is recorded. Named investors in aggregators include Y Combinator, Arch Grants, K3 Diversity Ventures, Mission Gate, Start-Up Chile, all unverified. The first outcome search returned only generic results; a second company search found no acquisition or shutdown. Competitors list empty because no dated competitor source was found; later searches did not surface any. Completeness pass: a 2019 grant of 50K (PitchBook) and a 125K seed in 2021-09 (TheCompanyCheck; PitchBook dates it 2021-09-23, CB Insights 2021-08-31) are recorded, each from a single database. Totals conflict (125K to 1.62M), so history may be incomplete.
